survey.notes: 150 of 2838 known pages surveyed (budget stop; last new feature on page 130). Site-wide: svg icons 98%, inputs 88% and forms 87% (the newsletter field in every footer), CSS/Web animation 64% (staggered fade-in reveals), large images 49%, card grids 41%, carousels 36%. Common: tables 29% (legal pages only), sticky header 26%, dialogs 26% (almost all the cookie banner). Occasional: Lottie 11% and illustration SVG 11% (home, therapy, app, AI-companion, science, topic pages — the hero-level pages), disclosures 11% (FAQ), banded sections 8%, transitions 8%. One-offs: logo wall 5%, quote 2%, autoplay video 2%, loop/rotate/svg motion 2% (three sleep articles — an embedded player spinner, not captured running), divider 1%, current-page marker 1%, code block 1% (a legal-page address block). Most-used button styles on 149 pages are the third-party cookie banner (2px radius, 13px) and are not the design; the brand's own buttons are 32px/50% pills in ink #2d2c2b and blue #0061ef (129–136 pages). 16 pages captured in depth.

character.summary: A sunny, toy-like wellness language: warm white and cream pages broken by full-bleed bands of flat, saturated color — yolk yellow, bright blue, tangerine, night navy — whose edges curve like a horizon, each topic owning one color. Its voice is a family of flat geometric shapes (circles, crescents, blobs, clouds, four-point sparkles) shaded with a single darker crescent, scattered as confetti around headings and set as round spot pictograms beside list items, with small glyphs that loop slowly as if breathing. Everything you touch is a soft, chunky pill in warm ink or blue that sits on a 2px ledge and sinks when pressed, set in a friendly bold grotesque with tight tracking.

color.notes: Two families: a warm neutral base (white 81% + cream 10% of painted area, warm-grey borders, warm near-black ink — never pure black or cool grey) and a set of flat, fully saturated 'toy' colors used as whole fields, never as tints or gradients on UI. Accent per screen: one saturated field dominates (a hero band, a feature panel or a closing band) and covers roughly 15–35% of a marketing screen; on reading pages (articles, legal) saturated color drops to the blue CTA, blue links and orange bullets (<3%). Topics are color-coded: meditation = yellow, mindfulness = blue, sleep = navy/violet, focus = green, kids = blue, therapy = cream + blue (screenshots p9, p10, p11, p14). Shapes combine two or three saturated colors side by side (orange on yellow, blue on pink, purple on green). The only gradients are the soft blurred clouds and the AI-companion orb (pink→orange) — newer one-offs. Dark appearance: none (theme.json supportsDark false); the sleep pages' night palette (navy #050726, indigo #201f52, violet #5432a5, white text, yellow accents) is the evidence a dark mode would be derived from.

motion.reducedMotion: The reference ships no prefers-reduced-motion rules (motion.json reducedMotionRules empty on every page); with reduced motion the capture shows Lottie scenes absent (the closing band renders as an empty yellow field, screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). The template will: show every shape, glyph and vignette in its final resting frame, replace fades with instant appearance, stop marquees and glyph loops, keep only color/background changes on hover and the 2px press offset (no transition).
motion.notes: Motion has two speeds. UI is snappy and small (150ms, one easing, 2px of travel). Illustration is slow and organic: shapes appear in 100ms-staggered fades, glyphs breathe on 5–9s loops with a strong ease-in-out, scenes play once on entry. Nothing slides in from far away, nothing bounces past its target; travel distances are tiny (2px for buttons, a few px for shapes) and scale changes stay within 87–148%. Lotties are tweened (0% cel frames), 30–60fps. The survey's motion:loop/rotate on three sleep articles is an unused spin keyframe (rotate 0 → 360°) of an embedded player/spinner that was not running during the deep capture — evidence missing, treated as a loading spinner.

theming.notes: No prefers-color-scheme rules, no toggle, no theme selectors on any of the 16 pages (theme.json). The sleep pages are a content-driven night palette (navy #050726 ground, indigo #201f52 panels, violet #5432a5 selection, deep-purple covers, white text, yellow accents, wavy band edges) — the template derives its dark appearance from it.

imagery.iconography: Small UI icons are solid filled glyphs, not strokes: 16px plus/chevrons in #44423f or #2d2c2b, 24px filled white or ink glyphs, 32px chevron in a cream square; social icons are white glyphs in 24px ink circles; checkmarks are solid green #02873e ticks. Rounded terminals, no outlines, one color per icon (inventory.json: 70+52+42 filled icons, strokes only on 2 icons). Expressive 58px glyphs (topic rows) are two-color flat shapes or one fat round-cap stroke (9px on 58px = 15% of the box).
imagery.illustration: Flat vector shapes with no outlines: circles, crescents, rounded blobs, hexagons, pills, clouds with flat bottoms, four-point sparkles (concave diamonds) and small flowers. Volume comes from one darker crescent of the same hue on one side (orange #ff7300 on #ff7e1d; grey on white) — never gradients or shadows. Two or three saturated colors per object, placed side by side or overlapping (a disc half-covered by a second color). Compositions are sparse and centered with generous empty field; sparkles and small dots scatter around the main object. Line work, when present, is a single thick round-cap stroke (≈10–15% of the object's size) in ink #141313. Some newer pieces add soft blurred gradient clouds (pink→orange→lavender) as a background layer. Characters with closed-eye smiling faces are the brand's mascots and do not carry over.
imagery.photography: Warm, natural-light portraits of real people, smiling, cropped into circles (on a saturated disc, often with a second-color crescent edge), rounded 16px rectangles, or blob shapes with an offset colored edge; overlaid with floating UI chips (avatar + name + small check badge) on translucent dark glass. App screenshots sit in black-bezel phone mockups, tilted ±8° on night bands. Photos never fill a band edge-to-edge; they are always framed by color.

signatures.name: Sunny color fields with arched edges
signatures.what: Whole sections painted in one flat saturated color — yolk yellow #ffce00, bright blue #0061ef, night navy #050726, tangerine #ff7300, green #02873e — on an otherwise white/cream page, with a curved band edge: a shallow arc (sagitta ≈ 50–80px across 1440px) on the bottom of hero bands and the top of closing bands, and a soft wave on night bands. Each topic owns a color and keeps it everywhere it appears (hero, panel, covers, tiles).
signatures.frequency: Hero band on every hub/service page (6 of 16 captured); closing band or arched cream footer on every brand page; color panels in carousels and the library on home/therapy/content; color stat tiles on 3 pages. Saturated grounds total ~5% of painted area site-wide but sit at the first and last screen of most pages.
signatures.recipe: 1) Choose a palette of 4–6 flat saturated hues (yellow, blue, orange, green, pink, night navy) plus a warm neutral base (white, cream #f9f4f2, warm ink #2d2c2b). Assign each top-level area/category of the product one hue and keep the mapping stable (store it as tokens: --field-1..n, each with a paired on-color: ink on yellow, white on blue/orange/green/navy). 2) Paint at most one saturated field per screen region: a full-bleed band (width 100%, padding 64–96px) or a contained panel (radius 24px). 3) Curve the band edge with an SVG or clip-path rather than a straight line: bottom of a hero `clip-path: ellipse(75% 100% at 50% 0)` or an absolutely positioned 1440×80 SVG path 'M0,0 H1440 V20 Q720,110 0,20 Z' in the band color; top of a closing band the mirror (concave). Night bands use a gentle two-crest wave. 4) Inside the field use the paired on-color for text, white/cream pills for actions (blue pill only on non-blue fields), and decorate only with flat shapes in the other palette hues. 5) Never tint the field (no 10% washes), never gradient it; cream #f9f4f2 is the only 'quiet' field.
signatures.motion: static (fields themselves don't move); content inside fades in 500ms ease-out with 100ms stagger.

applicationMap.use: Full-bleed band in the area's color with an arched bottom edge; title, one-line lead, one pill.
A row of 3–4 color stat tiles (8px radius, eyebrow, 48–64px number, caption) using category colors; the rest of the dashboard on white/cream.
Category color as a 6–8px dot or a filled pill on the active section; the sidebar stays white/cream.
Cream panels only; a single colored band at the top of the danger zone or plan section, never behind form fields.
Category color only in a leading 10px dot or a small filled tag per row; table body white.
A contained 24px-radius panel in the section's color with one flat shape composition and a white pill.
Night-navy or blue band; selected plan card in violet/ink with white check, others white.
Closing band in yellow (concave arched top) with one large centered pill; cream footer with arched top.
Each step's illustration panel takes the color of the topic chosen; progress dots in ink.

signatures.limits: One saturated field per viewport at most, two per page section pair; never behind dense text longer than ~3 lines or behind form inputs and tables. Pair text color strictly (ink on yellow/pink, white on blue/orange/green/navy/violet; check 4.5:1 — white on #ff7300 fails for body text, use it only at ≥24px bold or switch to ink). Arched edges only on full-bleed bands, not on cards. Reduced motion: unaffected.

signatures.name: Flat geometric shape kit with crescent shading and sparkle confetti
signatures.what: An illustration vocabulary built only from flat primitives — circles 33–133px, crescents, rounded blobs, flat-bottomed clouds, hexagons, pills, four-point concave sparkles (16–43px) and tiny dots — in the palette hues, no outlines, volume shown by one darker crescent of the same hue. Shapes scatter asymmetrically around headings (4–6 per heading), sit inside 110px circular plates beside feature items, and frame photos (portrait inside a saturated disc whose edge peeks out as a crescent of a second color).
signatures.frequency: On every brand page above the legal tier: confetti headings (home, therapy), spot-pictogram grids (8 of 16 captured), sparkles in every hero, photo-in-disc on coaching/about/organizations; article covers (thousands of /articles and /content pages) use the same flat-shape style.
signatures.recipe: Build each shape as inline SVG with fills only (no stroke): 1) Disc: <circle r=50> in hue A; shading = a second <path> crescent in a darker step of hue A (≈ -8% lightness) covering the lower-right 25–35% (create it as the disc minus an offset disc, offset 12–18% of r toward the upper-left). 2) Two-color disc: a disc in hue A with an irregular rounded polygon in hue B covering 50–70% of it, clipped to the disc (clipPath), edges rounded with 6–10% radii. 3) Sparkle: four-point star from four quadratic curves meeting at the center — 'M12 0 Q12 12 24 12 Q12 12 12 24 Q12 12 0 12 Q12 12 12 0Z' — rotated 0–20°, in yellow, pink or white. 4) Cloud: three overlapping circles on a flat base rectangle with 999px-radius ends, white/cream or sky blue; a second, smaller cloud in a lighter tint overlaps the first. 5) Spot plate: 110px circle in cream #f9f4f2 (or a saturated disc) containing a 60–70% sized pictogram made from 2–3 primitives. Palette per piece: max 3 hues + optional ink accent line (round-cap stroke 10–15% of the object's width, #141313). Compose asymmetrically: big shapes at ~1/4 and 3/4 of the width, small sparkles between, nothing touching text (≥24px clearance).
signatures.motion: Scroll entry: each shape opacity 0 → 1, 500ms ease-out, delays 0/100/200/300/400/500ms in reading order. Idle: optional slow drift (translate ±4px, rotate ±10°, 5–8s, cubic-bezier(0.75,0,0.25,1), alternate, infinite) on at most one shape. Reduced motion: shapes shown at rest, no drift.

applicationMap.use: 4–6 shapes and sparkles scattered around a centered heading; fade in staggered.
A 56–110px spot plate with a 2–3 primitive pictogram beside each group title.
One composed object (disc + crescent shading + cloud + 2 sparkles) at 160–220px above the message.
A grey/cream disc with a lavender crescent and a small rain-cloud; no sad faces, no red fields.
A single disc with crescent shading slowly rotating its crescent (or 3 dots popping in sequence).
Spot plates as category markers on stat tiles or card headers (32–48px), one sparkle maximum per card.
Photo or initials inside a saturated disc with a second-color crescent peeking from one side.
A 24px sparkle or a green disc with a white tick.
Full compositions per step, centered on the step's color field.

signatures.limits: Decoration never overlaps text, inputs or data; keep ≥24px clearance. Max one composition per card, max 6 confetti shapes per heading, none inside tables or form bodies. No faces on shapes (the closed-eye smile is the reference's mascot), no gradients except optional blurred cloud backgrounds, no outlines. Reduced motion: static.

signatures.name: Breathing glyphs
signatures.what: Small (58px) expressive glyphs — a fat zigzag stroke, a crescent with a sparkle, a spiral, a dot in a ring, two overlapping speech bubbles — that loop slowly forever: scaling 100 → 87% or 100 → 148% and rotating ±15–35° on a strong ease-in-out, 5–8.7s per cycle, as if inhaling and exhaling. Built as tweened Lottie (0% cel frames), strokes 6.9–9px on a 58px box with round caps, one or two flat colors each.
signatures.frequency: Home topic rows (6 glyphs at the top of the most visited page), the marquee band glyphs, AI/therapy pages with Lottie (Lottie on 11% of surveyed pages — the hero-level ones).
signatures.recipe: Inline SVG 48–64px viewBox. Stroke glyphs: one <path> with stroke-width 15% of the box (9px of 58), stroke-linecap round, stroke-linejoin round, no fill, in one palette hue (yellow zigzag, sky-blue spiral). Fill glyphs: 2–3 flat shapes (crescent + sparkle; disc in ring; two bubbles offset 30%, back one darker). Animate the group with CSS: `transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: breathe 6s cubic-bezier(0.75,0,0.25,1) infinite;` @keyframes breathe { 0%,50%,100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0) } 25% { transform: scale(.87) rotate(15deg) } 75% { transform: scale(.87) rotate(-35deg) } }. Variants: 'pulse' (scale 1 → 1.48 → 1 twice per 8s, on the front bubble only), 'orbit' (sparkle rotate 0 → 360° in 1.7s then rest 3s), 'pop' (three or four dots scale 0 → 1 → 0 over 1s, 67ms stagger). Give each glyph a different duration (5s, 6s, 7.3s, 8s) so a row never pulses in unison.
signatures.motion: loop, infinite: scale 100→87→100% + rotate 0→15°→0→-35°→0 over 5–8.7s, cubic-bezier(0.75,0,0.25,1); dots pop 0→100→0% scale in 1000ms with 67ms stagger. Under prefers-reduced-motion: animation: none, glyph at its rest frame.

applicationMap.use: One glyph at the end of each category row or nav card (like the topic rows), 40–58px.
A single glyph in the greeting/summary card header indicating today's state; never on every widget.
The 'pop' dots or a breathing disc as the loader (replaces spinners), 24–48px.
One breathing glyph at 64–96px above the empty message.
Choice tiles (mood, goal, plan) each with a glyph that breathes only while hovered/selected.
A sparkle 'orbit' once (no loop) next to the message.
Glyphs between repeated phrases in a thin yellow marquee band.
Static glyph as the section icon (no loop) — dense screens get the shape, not the motion.

signatures.limits: At most 6 looping glyphs visible at once and only in lists of choices or headers; never inside tables, inputs or next to numbers that update. Keep them ≤64px. Different durations per glyph. Pause when off-screen (IntersectionObserver) and under prefers-reduced-motion.

signatures.name: Chunky pills on a ledge
signatures.what: Every action is a fully round pill (radius 32px / 50% for circles) in warm ink #2d2c2b, action blue #0061ef or cream #f9f4f2, with a bold 16–18px label tracked -0.03em and a hard 2px ledge shadow (0 2px 0 rgba(65,61,69,0.2)) that disappears as the pill moves down 2px when pressed. Filter tabs are the same pills; the active one is ink with a small white dot before its label.
signatures.frequency: Site-wide: ink pills on 129–131/150 surveyed pages, circle buttons on 136/150; the 2px ledge is 55.6% of all shadows; the 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.94,0.6,1) transition is 83.5% of all transitions.
signatures.recipe: .pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:48px; padding:0 24px; border-radius:999px; border:2px solid transparent; font:700 16px/1.15 var(--font); letter-spacing:-0.03em; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(65,61,69,.2); transition: background-color .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s, transform .15s cubic-bezier(.32,.94,.6,1) } .pill:hover { background:#141313 } .pill:active { transform:translateY(2px); box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(65,61,69,0) } .pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0040ea; outline-offset:2px }. Variants: --blue (#0061ef, the one conversion action per screen), --cream (#f9f4f2, ink label, hover #e2ded9), --on-color (white bg, ink label, used on saturated fields), --outline (transparent, 2px ink or white border). Sizes: sm 40px/14px label, md 48px/16px, lg 56px/18px, mega 120–190px/48–80px label for a single closing CTA. Tab pill: same anatomy, inactive cream, active ink + `::before` 10px white circle.
signatures.motion: hover: background one step darker, 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.94,0.6,1); press: translateY(0 → 2px) + ledge shadow alpha 0.2 → 0, 150ms; no scale, no lift. Reduced motion: same states, transition 0ms.

applicationMap.use: Submit = ink or blue pill (lg), secondary = cream pill; inline field actions = circle buttons.
Row actions as 32px circle buttons in cream; table filters as small tab pills above the table.
Segmented time-range tabs as pills (active ink + dot); primary 'create' as blue pill in the header.
Save = ink pill; destructive = cream pill with red label (derived); toggles as pill-shaped switches with the same ledge.
Footer with cream 'cancel' and ink/blue confirm pills, right-aligned, 12px apart.
One centered pill (ink) to recover; never two primaries.
Header CTA pill at the far right; mobile: compact blue pill next to the menu icon.
48px cream circle arrows and numbered circle pages (active ink with white digit).

signatures.limits: One blue pill per screen region (it is the conversion color); ink pills for everything else primary. Never square or 4–8px-radius buttons. Never add drop-shadow blur to buttons — the ledge is a hard 2px line. Labels ≤ 3 words, sentence case.

signatures.name: Product vignettes on color
signatures.what: Small, readable fragments of the product — a message bubble and a 'thinking…' bubble, a search field typing a query, an 'in-network' chip with avatar and check, a session card — floating over a saturated panel or a photo, building themselves in sequence when scrolled into view. White 16px-radius bubbles with a 10px colored status dot and 14px bold sender label.
signatures.frequency: Home feature carousel (5 panels), therapy hero, organizations hero, coaching hero; the hero-level pages of every product line (Lottie/illustration 11% of surveyed pages, each at the top).
signatures.recipe: Inside a 24px-radius color panel (or around a rounded photo), place 1–3 UI fragments built from real components: white cards radius 16px, padding 16px 20px, a 10px status dot (blue for the user, orange for the system) + 14px/700 name + 16px body; or a 56px search pill with an icon and a typing caret; or a glass chip (rgba(20,19,19,.45) with backdrop-filter blur(8px), radius 999px, 32px avatar + 14px/700 name + small check badge). Offset fragments diagonally (overlap 10–20%) so they read as a moment in a conversation. Sequence: fragment 1 at rest; fragment 2 enters at 40% opacity with placeholder text ('…'), then fills to 100% with real text after 750ms.
signatures.motion: Scroll-triggered once: opacity 0 → 0.4 → 1 and translateY 8px → 0 per fragment, 750ms cubic-bezier(0.48,0.04,0.52,0.96), 300–600ms between fragments; typing: one character per 60–80ms with a caret blinking at 1s. Reduced motion: show the final frame.

applicationMap.use: A vignette of the product's key action on the hero's color field.
A ghosted vignette of what the screen will look like (one card at 40% opacity) with the call to action.
Each step shows the fragment the user is about to create, building in.
A single fragment in a cream panel beside the explanation.
The 'thinking…' bubble pattern (40% opacity card with three popping dots) for AI or long tasks.
Recent-activity card styled as a conversation fragment (dot + name + one line).
Answer previews as message bubbles.

signatures.limits: Max one vignette per screen; fragments must be real-sized and legible (≥14px), never fake lorem UI; no device mockups inside product screens (mockups are for marketing). Reduced motion: final frame.

writing.casing: Sentence case everywhere — headings, buttons, tabs, nav; uppercase only for 14px eyebrows/stat labels on the organizations site.
writing.tone: Warm, plain, second person, short; reassuring rather than clinical; verbs first on buttons ('try…', 'check…', 'get started'); headings are full short sentences or phrases with no terminal period.
writing.notes: Buttons 1–3 words; questions are used as section headings and FAQ rows; checklists with green ticks carry benefits; footnote markers (superscript numbers) for claims. Style only — no copy carries over.

doNot: Do not draw faces (closed-eye smiles, eyes, mouths) on shapes — that is the reference's mascot system.
Do not use a single orange dot as a logo or brand mark.
Do not use gradients, glows or drop shadows on UI or flat shapes; volume is a darker crescent, elevation is a 2px ledge.
Do not tint the saturated colors into pastel washes behind content; a field is either full-strength color or white/cream.
Do not use square or slightly-rounded buttons; every action is a pill or circle.
Do not put more than one saturated field in a viewport or more than one blue pill in a region.
Do not use cool greys or pure black; neutrals are warm (cream, warm grey, warm ink).
Do not animate with bounces, long slides or parallax; UI moves 2px in 150ms, decoration fades and breathes slowly.
Do not outline the illustration shapes or icons; everything is flat fill (strokes only as one fat round-cap gesture).
Do not put decoration over data, inputs or tables.

referenceSet.shows: Home first screen: bold centered headline, cream rounded product panels with a floating vignette (phone, cards, a bubble, a sparkle), ink pills, blue header pill on a yellow announcement bar. The bar for hierarchy and warmth of the neutral base.

A topic hero at its best: full-bleed yolk-yellow band with an arched bottom, 64px tight headline, green-tick checklist, blue pill, photo cut into a blob with an offset orange edge, cloud and four-point sparkles.
The night palette: navy band, white type, indigo audio panel with a yellow progress knob, white pill, tilted app mockups — the basis for the derived dark appearance.
Phone: yellow hero band stacked, centered text, compact header with dot + blue pill + menu, spot-pictogram list with underlined titles, cream info card and circle pagination.
Topic rows with breathing glyphs: bordered 8px rows, 22px labels, flat two-color glyphs and chevrons — the signature glyph scale and density for lists.

Confetti heading: two-color discs and sparkles scattered around a 64px heading, cream 16px-radius testimonial cards. (The faces on the discs are the mascot and must not be copied — the composition, sizes and colors are the bar.)
Spot pictograms in cream circular plates beside bold item titles — the flat shape kit at small scale, with crescent shading and sparkles.
Color stat tiles: four saturated fields with eyebrow, big bold number and caption — how the language carries data.
A form inside a cream 24px panel with warm-grey selects, a blurred-cloud illustration, and the pill tabs with the active ink pill + white dot.
The button family: bordered topic rows, cream and ink pills with dot, circle arrows and play buttons.
The pill's states: default on its 2px ledge, darker hover, pressed (sunk 2px, ledge gone) with the blue focus ring.
FAQ rows with warm rules and plus icons, then the yellow closing band with a concave arched top and the mega blue pill.

Logo: the orange dot + lowercase wordmark; do not use an orange (or any single) dot as a logo mark.
Mascot characters: shapes with closed-eye smiling faces, googly-eye pairs, the orange smiling sphere and the shape mosaic with faces — no faces on any shape.
Proprietary fonts: Apercu / 'Headspace Apercu' / Apercu Mono (Colophon) → Figtree and DM Mono (OFL).
Artwork: all Lottie scenes, article/cover illustrations, sleep illustrations, photography of members, therapists and teachers, app screenshots.
Copy and taglines: hero headlines, the 'find some …' marquee phrase, the closing mega-CTA phrase, testimonials, stats and claims.
Partner and insurer logos in the logo walls.
